messages: Complex PDF layout and exact text placement are not fully preserved. Inferred headings, tables and column order may need review.
Vector drawings and unsupported page graphics are not exported as separate assets; inspect visual content in the source PDF.
The Linux PDF backend infers word spacing and bounded text-line order; only pages actually processed with structured OCR can reconstruct tables.
A PDF link target was retained as literal text because it was unsafe, unsupported or outside selected pages.
Embedded PDF images were retained as local PNG assets; their original compression and page placement were not preserved.
